spec.root_policy: frozen dw4i_s1 student; original task45 f8/f8x
spec.root_selection: initial legal decision plus temporally spaced later legal student decisions, frozen before terminal labels; final density chosen from timing-only pilot
spec.candidates: all engine legal plant packet/row/col combinations plus wait:60/timeout; never static/top-k filtering
spec.terminal_policy: same frozen search teacher applied immediately after candidate, all the way to a real terminal; no short-student-prefix terminal labels
spec.leaf_comparison: formal 2500-tick student continuation + v4 leaf on same candidate/common future; terminal-before-horizon uses true win/loss; separate teacher-path v4 auxiliary
spec.rank_pairs: strict ground-truth pairs and thresholds reported separately; v4 ties half credit; cluster bootstrap over paired episode seeds, not candidate pairs
spec.confirmation: independent future seeds; one root per level/observation, chosen from screening by largest mean-wave gain; compare screening wave/tick/win favourites, v4 favourite, student and wait with paired sign tests and Holm correction

reuse.access: read-only; frozen source copy in ignored phase-e/frozen

sampling.selection_rule: first legal decision and closest legal decision to tick8000; ties earlier; labels never inputs
sampling.forecast_method: mean measured CPU of pilot candidates at roots within1500ticks, otherwise global mean; no outcome fields used
sampling.shared_future_scope: all candidates within a root; reset seeds paired across observation arms, future hashes include arm/root identity

confirmation.significance: one-sided paired sign test; zeros omitted; Holm across all candidates/metrics/eight selected roots
confirmation.seed_independence: fresh 16 futures disjoint from 3 screening futures; selected roots/candidates remain a diagnostic subset

ranking_note: Reported agreements compare noisy 3-future candidate means; strict/thresholded/true-nonterminal leaf pairs separated. Cluster bootstrap samples paired base seeds, never individual candidate pairs.
policy_note: Original root trajectories are student decisions. All branch terminal labels execute candidate immediately then the pinned frozen search teacher; no v4 terminal cutoff and no 2500-tick student prefix on terminal path.
